ADC_PAGE_ITEM_TYPES

Table to store page item types supported by ADC.

Columns
cpit_id

PK, alphanumerical key

cpit_pti_id

Reference to PIT_TRANSLATABLE_ITEM, translatable NAME

cpit_pmg_name

Reference to PIT_TRANSLATABLE_ITEM, fixed to ADC

cpit_cpitg_id

Group of the page item type, reference to ADC_PAGE_ITEM_TYPE_GROUPS

cpit_cet_id

JavaScript event to be bound to this element type by the plugin

cpit_col_template

Template for creating a column in the decision table

cpit_init_template

Template for generating the initialization code

References

cpit_pti_id, cpit_pmg_name -> PIT_TRANSLATABLE_ITEM (pti_uid, pti_upmg) cpit_cpitg_id - references ADC_PAGE_ITEM_TYPE_GROUPS (cpitg_id) cpit_cet_id - references ADC_EVENT_TYPES (cet_id)
